summary: A trim chunk that holds the store's writer over 1 s logs one WARN line with its phase, envelopes, claims, the bytes of the claim bodies it deleted, and its hold split into step and commit time

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently.

compatibility.detail: Only a log line is added; each delete chunk also reads the length of the bodies it deletes.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.
